description: This file defines the TemporalExpressionPrinter class which provides a pretty-printing implementation for TemporalExpression objects in the org.apache.ofbiz.service.calendar package. It implements the TemporalExpressionVisitor interface to traverse and format various types of temporal expression objects for readability.

classes.name: TemporalExpressionPrinter
classes.description: A class responsible for generating a human-readable string representation of TemporalExpression objects by traversing their structure using the visitor pattern.

methods.name: appendExpression
methods.description: Appends a string representation of a TemporalExpression to the internal StringBuilder, with appropriate indentation.

methods.name: appendIndent
methods.description: Adds indentation spaces to the StringBuilder based on current indentation level.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Increases the current indentation level by the configured indent size.

methods.name: unIndent
methods.description: Decreases the current indentation level by the configured indent size.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Initiates the visit of the expression to build the string representation and returns the final string.
